title: 2-Hour Private Sailing Experience in San Diego Bay
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our unique sail displays a peace sign because that is exactly what we share with our customers, peace. Peace is not always an easy thing to obtain in today's world. With all the stress life brings we are happy to provide a peaceful experience that you can take with you after your journey. Everyone in the bay can feel and see this message of peace as we sail through San Diego. Enjoy being on the water and allow yourself to connect with the sea. 

Sailing yacht Mojave is clean, luxurious, and very spacious. Sterling Sails is proud to be a woman owned business. Everything is included in this experience. There are complementary snacks and beverages on board, or you can bring whatever you would like. One bottle of champagne is provided for every charter. Available on board we have a speaker, a refrigerator, and a restroom. Ask the captain for anything you need. Our number one priority is making sure you are comfortable and taken care of. Sail in Peace with Sterling Sails.
